title: MicroSim Growth Network Effect
description: A reinforcing feedback system showing how MicroSims, Intelligent Textbooks, and Teacher Awareness create a virtuous cycle of growth through network effects.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Trace the R1 textbook growth loop from Intelligent Textbooks through Teachers Aware to Demand for Textbooks
Distinguish the stock variables from the demand variables in the MicroSim growth diagram
Explain why every edge carrying positive polarity makes both loops reinforcing rather than balancing
Predict how a barrier to MicroSim creation would slow the R1 and R2 loops
Identify Teachers Aware as the shared variable that couples the two reinforcing loops
